blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At the first Philippine Summit on Localizing Climate Change and Nature-Based Solutions, Sustainable Tourism and Creative Industries Development, Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Wednesday night called on government leaders, scientists, and development partners to work together in protecting the environment, saying that one of the greatest legacies Filipinos can leave their children and grandchildren is a safer, cleaner, and better world. Speaking during the Speaker’s Night dinner, the House leader urged summit participants to look beyond policy discussions and technical solutions and reflect on their shared responsibility to preserve the country’s natural resources for future generations.
